summary: As a Quality Doc SME, I want to initiate the Send for Review And Verification workflow on a Draft document so that a designated reviewer is formally assigned to evaluate the document

acceptanceCriteria.text: The Quality Doc SME can log in to Veeva Vault QualityDocs using valid credentials and is presented with the QualityDocs interface
After login, the Quality Doc SME can navigate to the Full Library view
The Quality Doc SME can search for a document by name ("Test1 for Workflow") and the document appears in search results
The Quality Doc SME can open the document and view it in Draft state
The "Send for Review And Verification" user action is visible and available on the Draft document
The Quality Doc SME can click "Send for Review And Verification" and a reviewer selection prompt or form is displayed
The Quality Doc SME can select a reviewer account (Test_user01) and submit the workflow initiation
After submission, the document transitions from Draft state to In Review
The assigned reviewer (Test_user01) receives or has access to the workflow task
If the Quality Doc SME navigates to QualityDocs via the module URL directly, the Full Library is accessible from the navigation
The "Send for Review And Verification" action is not available on a document that is not in Draft state
The workflow cannot be initiated without selecting a reviewer — submission without a reviewer is prevented
Only the Quality Doc SME role can initiate the workflow; the Reviewer role does not have access to the "Send for Review And Verification" action
The document must be in Draft state for the "Send for Review And Verification" action to be available (RP-BIZ-001)
Only a user with the Quality Doc SME role can trigger this workflow action (RP-BIZ-002)
Selecting a reviewer is a mandatory step when initiating the workflow — the system enforces this requirement (RP-BIZ-003)

HP.description: Complete workflow initiation — SME logs in, searches for Draft document, opens it, initiates "Send for Review And Verification", selects reviewer, submits successfully, document transitions to In Review, reviewer receives task

AP.description: Alternative navigation path — SME navigates via module URL directly to Full Library and executes workflow

NEG.description: Invalid login credentials — SME attempts login with incorrect username or password
Non-existent document search — SME searches for a document name that does not exist in the library
Non-Draft document state — SME opens a document that is not in Draft state (e.g., In Review, Approved) and "Send for Review And Verification" action is not available
Wrong role access — User with Reviewer role attempts to initiate "Send for Review And Verification" workflow and is denied access to the action

ERR.description: Missing reviewer selection — SME clicks "Send for Review And Verification", does not select a reviewer, and attempts to submit; system prevents submission

INT.description: Reviewer task assignment verification — After SME submits workflow, verify that Test_user01 has the workflow task in their task inbox with correct document reference
Document state persistence — After workflow submission, verify document state is "In Review" across all library views and document detail pages
